query: 67-year-old female with AMI: among females 62–72 without shock or respiratory failure, compare in‑hospital mortality LOS ≤5 vs >5 days; report mortality rates, CKD and diabetes prevalence, and absolute/relative mortality differences.
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL AND a.los <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL AND a.los > 5 THEN 1 END), 0) AS mortality_ratio, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.ckd_stage = 'ckd1' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.ckd_stage = 'ckd2' THEN 1 END), 0) AS ckd_ratio, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '100000000' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '100000001' THEN 1 END), 0) AS diabetes_ratio, (COUNT(CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL AND a.los <= 5 THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN p.ckd_stage = 'ckd1' THEN 1 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL AND a.los > 5 THEN 1 END), 0) AS absolute_mortality_difference, (COUNT(CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL AND a.los <= 5 THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN p.ckd_stage = 'ckd1' THEN 1 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL AND a.los > 5 THEN 1 END), 0) * 100 AS relative_mortality_difference FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE a.gender = 'F' AND a.anchor_age = 67 AND d.diagnosis_code IN ('100000000', '100000001') AND (a.los <= 5 OR a.los > 5) AND (p.ckd_stage != 'ckd1' OR p.ckd_stage != 'ckd2') AND (d.diagnosis_code != '100000000' OR d.diagnosis_code != '100000001') AND (a.deathtime IS NOT NULL OR a.dischtime IS NOT NULL);
